title: GLC Kozhikode gets provisional BCI affiliation; Kerala HC closes case filed over affiliation lapse
description: The Kerala High Court on Monday closed a plea concerning the lack of Bar Council of India (BCI) affiliation for courses offered by Government Law College (GLC), Kozhikode, after noting that the college has now been granted a provisional affiliation by the BCI for 6 months [Muhammed Anwar Saidu v Bar Council of India & Ors].Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas noted that the college had cleared the pending payments and complied with all conditions stipulated by the BCI for the grant of provisional aff
